title: NSU Prinz - troblja (vehicle horn)
author: Work With Sounds / Technical Museum of Slovenia
processing: Excerpt 0.28-0.90 seconds. Mono PCM16 WAV at 32 kHz. High-pass 140 Hz, low-pass 6500 Hz, 4 ms fade-in and 50 ms fade-out from 0.57 s. Peak normalized to -1.5 dBFS. No pitch shift.
note: A real vintage vehicle horn used as an arcade tuk-tuk sound, not a recording of a Bangkok tuk-tuk.
